metadata.description: Retrieved context chunks per test case — simulates the RAG layer in Tier 1. In Tier 2 this is replaced by real ChromaDB retrieval from policy_docs/
metadata.note: Each entry maps to an email ID. Chunks should come from policy documents relevant to the email intent.

retrieved_chunks: Personal loan eligibility requires minimum monthly income of Rs. 15,000.
Applicant must have minimum 1 year of continuous employment.
No existing loan defaults in the last 24 months.
Maximum loan amount is 10x monthly income for salaried individuals.
Documents required: Salary slips (3 months), Bank statements (6 months), Aadhaar, PAN card, Employment letter.
EMI failures can occur due to technical issues at bank or payment gateway.
No penalty is charged for the first failed EMI if payment is made within 3 days of due date.
Customer must make manual payment via NEFT, UPI or branch visit within 3 working days.
If EMI remains unpaid beyond 30 days, account is marked as NPA.
Customer support can initiate a re-presentation of ECS mandate within 24 hours.
All interest rate disputes must be escalated to the Grievance Redressal Officer within 24 hours.
RBI guidelines require grievance acknowledgement within 24 hours of receipt.
Resolution of rate disputes must happen within 15 working days per RBI mandate.
Customer has the right to approach RBI Banking Ombudsman if unresolved in 30 days.
Any rate change must be communicated to customer 30 days in advance per RBI circular.
Foreclosure is allowed after 12 months of regular EMI payments.
Foreclosure charges: 2% of outstanding principal if closed before 24 months.
Zero foreclosure charges after 24 months of loan tenure.
Foreclosure statement takes 2 working days to generate.
Payment can be made via RTGS, NEFT or demand draft in favour of the company.
KYC address update requires self-attested copy of new address proof.
Accepted address proofs: Aadhaar card, Utility bill (not older than 3 months), Rent agreement, Passport.
KYC update can be done online via customer portal or by visiting nearest branch.
Processing time for KYC update is 5-7 working days.
Customer will receive SMS and email confirmation upon successful update.
Business loan processing time is 7-10 working days from date of complete document submission.
Application status can be tracked on the customer portal using application reference number.
If documents are incomplete, customer is notified within 3 working days.
Loan sanctioning team reviews applications in order of receipt.
Customer can call dedicated loan helpline for status update.
RBI allows restructuring of loans for borrowers facing genuine financial hardship.
Moratorium of up to 3 months can be granted on case-by-case basis.
Restructuring request must be evaluated by credit team within 7 working days.
Customer must submit proof of financial hardship (job loss letter, income proof).
Interest continues to accrue during moratorium period.
Processing fees are disclosed in the Key Fact Statement (KFS) signed by customer at loan disbursement.
RBI mandates all fees to be disclosed upfront before loan disbursal.
Mis-selling complaints must be escalated to Grievance Redressal Officer immediately.
If customer did not receive KFS, this constitutes a compliance breach.
Refund of processing fee is possible only if non-disclosure is proven after investigation.
Customer has right to approach RBI Banking Ombudsman if complaint unresolved in 30 days.
Nominee can be added or changed at any time during the loan tenure.
Documents required: Nominee Aadhaar card copy, Nominee photograph, Signed nominee declaration form.
Nominee declaration form is available on customer portal and at branch.
Processing time for nominee update is 3-5 working days.
Nominee does not have legal rights over loan but is informed in case of borrower's demise.
The company offers personal loans, business loans, and microfinance products.
Current offers: Zero processing fee on personal loans above Rs. 1,00,000 till 30th April.
The company does not provide investment or stock market advisory services.
Customers must consult a SEBI-registered investment advisor for investment advice.
Double EMI deduction is treated as a critical issue requiring immediate resolution.
Duplicate EMI deductions must be reversed within 2 working days with written confirmation.
Cases involving legal threats or consumer court mentions must be escalated immediately.
Customer must receive acknowledgement within 2 hours for critical complaints.
Refund of duplicate deduction processed via NEFT within 2 working days.
Company does not offer investment products or fixed deposits.
Any claims of guaranteed returns must be immediately escalated as potential mis-selling.
Customers seeking investment advice should be referred to SEBI-registered advisors.
Company only offers loan products — no deposit or investment schemes.
Using terms like guaranteed returns or assured returns in customer communication is prohibited.
EMI failures can occur due to technical issues at bank or payment gateway.
No penalty is charged for the first failed EMI if payment is made within 3 days.
Customer can visit branch to make manual EMI payment.
Customer support can initiate re-presentation of ECS mandate within 24 hours.
Non-English customer communications must be routed to the multilingual support team.
Customer identity verification must be done before sharing any account information.
PAN, Aadhaar, and bank account numbers must never be shared over email.
Customers can visit branch with valid photo ID to retrieve account details.
KYC details can be updated only through authenticated channels — not email.
Sharing customer PII over unverified channels is a compliance and regulatory violation.
Customer must provide loan account number for any account-related queries.
Without account details, customer support cannot access or modify any account.
Standard response for vague queries: request account number and description of issue.
Do not assume or guess the nature of the customer's problem without sufficient information.
